content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"It resolves the D3-C6 Isaiah 7:14 collision by referencing the sign verse's own silence on the mechanism rather than weighing the competing chains by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the sign itself does not state the mechanism","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"The phrase I interpreted was 'the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires'; I weighed whether the judge merely noted a gap in the sign verse versus whether it used the sign's failure to state the mechanism as the retired stating-verse test, and the latter reading fits the text.","why":"Because it uses the sign's failure to state the mechanism as decisive, it applies the retired stating-verse test instead of weighing CR2's and DR3's chains by footing."}
